title: llmeval configuration
description: Configuration for llmeval — LLM response quality evaluator

dataset_size.description: Default number of prompts to generate per evaluation run. Overridden by task-level dataset_size or --dataset-size flag.

concurrency.description: Max parallel API calls. Overridden by task-level concurrency or --concurrency flag.

model_config.description: Default generation parameters sent to every provider.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the model response.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. 0 = deterministic, higher = more creative.

providers.description: Named provider instances. Built-in providers (groq, openai, anthropic, openrouter, deepinfra) are pre-wired — only add entries here to override or extend.

models.description: Optional model aliases. Without this, use '<provider>/<model-name>' directly in --models or task configs.

harden.description: Prompt hardening pipeline config. Run with: llmeval harden --all

judge_model.description: Informational — the Claude Code session acts as judge. Set to the model slug you want recorded in audit logs.

max_iterations.description: Maximum harden iterations per prompt. 0 = unlimited (run until stop condition met).

confirmation_runs.description: Re-runs of the full probe set when findings == 0, to confirm the prompt is genuinely clean. 0 = skip confirmation (faster but less reliable).

probe_runs.description: How many times to run each probe. A finding is recorded if triggered in at least one run. Values > 1 reduce false negatives from stochastic model outputs.

skip_golden.description: Skip golden-query validation after each patch. Use for stable prompts where regression testing is not needed. Can be overridden per-prompt in the manifest.

cache.description: Skip the harden run if the prompt file hash is unchanged from the last completed run. Re-runs automatically when the prompt changes. Can be overridden per-prompt in the manifest.

until.description: Stop conditions for the harden loop.

findings_eq.description: Stop when the findings count equals this value. Typically 0 (stop when clean).

run_dir.description: Directory for per-prompt checkpoint state (one subdirectory per prompt stem).

audit_log.description: Append-only JSONL log of completed harden runs — one line per prompt, includes iteration count, patch count, final status, and probe language.

type.description: 'openai_compat' covers Groq, OpenRouter, DeepInfra, Ollama, LM Studio, and any /v1/chat/completions endpoint. 'anthropic' uses the native Messages API.

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider API (required for openai_compat; not used for anthropic). Example: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1

api_key_env.description: Override the env var name for the API key. Defaults to UPPER(provider_name)_API_KEY (e.g. 'groq' → GROQ_API_KEY). Useful when sharing a key across multiple provider entries or for non-standard key names.

timeout_secs.description: HTTP client timeout in seconds for this provider. Increase for slow local endpoints (e.g. Ollama on CPU). Default: 120s.

enabled.description: Set to false to remove a built-in provider entirely. Prevents accidental API calls and hides it from 'llmeval providers' output.

id.description: Model ID used in --models and task configs. Convention: '<provider>/<alias>'. Example: groq/llama-3.3-70b

provider.description: Must match a key under providers: (built-in or custom).

model_name.description: Exact model name sent to the provider API. Example: llama-3.3-70b-versatile

description.description: Task prompt passed to Claude for dataset generation. Equivalent to /llmeval --task "..."

system.description: Default system prompt injected into every generated prompt. Individual hand-crafted prompts can override this.

params.description: Scoring dimensions for pointwise mode. Omit to let Claude auto-select based on the task description.

models.description: Models to compare. Use '<provider>/<model-name>' format or aliases defined under models:. Overridden by --models flag.

dataset_size.description: Number of prompts to generate for this task. Overrides global dataset_size.

mode.description: 'pointwise': each response scored 1–5 per param. 'pairwise': head-to-head matchups with Elo ratings.

concurrency.description: Max parallel API calls for this task. Overrides global concurrency.
